description.text: Teaching Objectives To cultivate high-qualified and skilled talents who are proficient in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good understanding of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so that they can meet the demands of the fast changing world economy. Main Courses Introduction to Business, Financial Accounting, Strategy Management,International Business,International Finance and Banking,Marketing Basics, Human Resource Management, Information and Data Management, Managerial Accounting, Management Essentials, Organizational Behavior, Basic Statistics, Basic Mathematics of Commerce, Microeconomics, Operational Management, International Trade, Customer Relationship MG, International Law and International Relations, Business Finance, Cross Cultural Communication for Effective Leadership and MGT Internship With CPD’s (Center of Professional Development) help, students can be recommended to transnational companies for internship to get their work experience in the last semester. Industry partners of CPD include Standard Chartered Bank, ABN AMRO BANK, HSBC, Hang Seng Bank, United Overseas Bank, Xinhua Finance, Coca Cola, IBM, Apple, HP, Dell, Imaginex, Microsoft, Motorola, NOKIA, Vogue, ELLE, Samsung, Finnair, IKEA, Tiffany, L'oreal, Elite Ogilvy, AKQA, Dunhill, Hugo Boss, Louis Vuitton, Cartier, Ferragamo, ZARA, Adidas, Nike, Prada, Giorgio Armani, and many more... Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Management in Business Administration (BBA) Future Career Students will be provided the opportunities to be engaged in industrial cooperative projects, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, interview techniques, and career consultation.

duration.text: The Bachelor of Management in Business Administration at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate, in good health 2.HSK Band 6 or above
